title: Marvelous Sign of Wisdom
text: Upgrade a Crystal Sign through ordinary assembly. It can stand, hang or mount on a wall, showing the same message on both sides with light level 15 and white starlight.
Right-click to draw another saying. Each sign has its own nonrepeating round; after all sayings are drawn, a new round begins. Its message and progress persist.
Text is fixed black glowing lettering; it cannot be edited or dyed.
